text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help diagnose your condition, I need to know: for how long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and have you noticed any fevers or difficulty breathing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned an enlarged supraclavicular lymph node; have you noticed any other lumps in your neck, armpits, or groin? I also need to know if you have had any recent travel or exposure to tuberculosis.

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The fixed nature of the node is concerning, so I need to check for other signs of systemic involvement. Do you experience any itching all over your body, or have you noticed any swelling in your abdomen?
